extraction.name: OWSM v4
extraction.description: A series of fully open speech foundation models and a cleaned dataset derived from YODAS, comprising 166,000 hours of speech across 75 languages, created using a scalable data-cleaning pipeline.
extraction.creator: Yifan Peng, Muhammad Shakeel, Yui Sudo, William Chen, Jinchuan Tian, Chyi-Jiunn Lin, Shinji Watanabe
extraction.citeAs: Yifan Peng, Muhammad Shakeel, Yui Sudo, William Chen, Jinchuan Tian, Chyi-Jiunn Lin, Shinji Watanabe. OWSM v4: Improving Open Whisper-Style Speech Models via Data Scaling and Cleaning. Interspeech 2025.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Integration of YODAS, a large-scale web-crawled dataset, alongside existing OWSM data.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: YODAS (Youtube-Oriented Dataset for Audio and Speech)
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: 1. Resegmentation of long-form audio using CTC segmentation algorithm (max 30s duration, removal of non-speech). 2. LID-based filtering using fastText (text) and SpeechBrain ECAPA-TDNN (audio) to remove incorrect language labels. 3. CTC-score-based filtering to remove low-quality audio-text alignments (threshold θCTC = 0.10).
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: The raw YODAS data contains annotations (transcriptions with timestamps). The process involves verifying and filtering these existing annotations using LID and CTC confidence scores, and realigning audio and text using CTC segmentation.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Analysis of CTC scores showed that without filtering (θCTC = 0.00), performance was poor and unstable with decoding getting stuck in repetitions, confirming substantial misalignment issues in raw data.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The data-cleaning pipeline, cleaned YODAS data, training code, pre-trained model weights, and training logs will be publicly released.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: Advances open academic research by providing fully open models and data, addressing concerns about privacy, transparency, and reproducibility associated with closed models like Whisper.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The distribution across languages is highly imbalanced. English constitutes the largest share, whereas many other languages continue to be underrepresented.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Highly imbalanced language distribution (English dominant). The original distribution is kept without resampling. Raw data contains incorrect language labels and audio-text misalignments which required cleaning.
